Thinking About Adding On? Here's What You Need to Know

Your home is running out of room — or maybe it just doesn't fit your life the way it used to. A growing family, a new work-from-home setup, an aging parent moving in — there are a hundred reasons people start searching for a home addition contractor near me. If you're in Wichita or the surrounding area, Wheatland Construction is the local team built for this exact kind of work.

We're not a remodeling franchise or a national chain. We're a Wichita-based general contractor that knows this market, these neighborhoods, and what it takes to build an addition that looks like it was always part of your home.

What Is a Home Addition, Exactly?

A home addition is any project that increases your home's square footage by attaching new construction to the existing structure. That can mean a lot of different things depending on what you need:

  • Room additions — a bedroom, home office, or playroom added to the main floor
  • Master suite additions — extra square footage for a larger bedroom, walk-in closet, or ensuite bath
  • In-law suites — a semi-private living space for a family member
  • Garage conversions or add-ons — attached garages with finished living space above or adjacent
  • Sunrooms and covered porches — semi-conditioned spaces that extend your living area seasonally or year-round
  • Second-story additions — going up instead of out when lot space is limited

Each type has its own structural, permitting, and design challenges. That's why experience matters.

Why Local Matters for This Kind of Project

A home addition isn't like replacing a roof or installing new floors. It involves foundation work, framing, rooflines, exterior siding, mechanical systems — and it all has to tie into your existing structure cleanly. If something is off, you'll see it (and feel it) for decades.

Hiring a home addition contractor in Wichita, KS who knows local building codes, works with city and county permit offices regularly, and understands the soil conditions and climate here isn't just a convenience — it's a real advantage. Wheatland Construction has built that local knowledge through hands-on work across Wichita and the surrounding communities.

What the Process Looks Like With Wheatland

We keep things straightforward. Here's a general overview of how a home addition project moves from idea to finished space:

1. Initial Consultation

We walk the property with you, talk through your goals, and get a realistic picture of scope and budget. No pressure, no inflated estimates to walk back later.

2. Design & Planning

We work with you (and any architects or designers involved) to finalize the layout, materials, and structural approach. We handle permit applications and coordinate with the city.

3. Site Prep & Foundation

Before a single wall goes up, the foundation has to be right. We do this work carefully — it's not the glamorous part, but it determines how everything above it performs.

4. Framing, Mechanical, and Envelope

Framing, roofline integration, windows, insulation, HVAC rough-in, electrical, plumbing — all sequenced and inspected as required.

5. Finishes

Drywall, flooring, trim, paint, fixtures. This is where the space starts to feel like home.

6. Final Walkthrough

We don't call it done until you're satisfied. We do a final walkthrough together and address anything that needs attention.

Common Questions About Home Additions in

Wichita

How long does a home addition take?
Most additions take 3–6 months from permit approval to completion, depending on size and complexity. Larger or multi-story projects can run longer.

Do I need a permit for a home addition in Wichita?
Yes. Any addition that increases your home's footprint requires permits from the City of Wichita. Wheatland handles this process for you.

Will the addition match my existing home?
That's always the goal. We pay close attention to roofline, siding, window style, and exterior finish to make sure the addition looks like it belongs — not like it was bolted on later.
